_primary_metric_hint: The one number THIS workflow optimises — commonly watch_through_rate, then views. A channel can still override it in shared/channels.json.
_comment: This folder is fully self-contained: its own experiments, sources, templates, inputs, runs and reports. Want a second video workflow with a different goal or audience? Copy this whole folder to a new name (e.g. video-partners/), rewrite this file's goal and metric, and run it independently. The folder name is the workflow name; 'type' maps it to the engine-video skill.

video._note: Knobs engine-video reads. 9:16 vertical is the default, not a law — set 1920x1080 for a YouTube-landscape strategy and say so in brand.md.
